instance origin: the dungeon and raid list marks each instance new in WoW: Forever or from the original game; the nine new dungeons confirmed by Warcraft Tavern's Forever dungeon announcement, the instance map IDs (2959-3065) by the client's DungeonEncounter table

points.name: Shaper's Terrace (outside portal)
points.note: Hill overlooking Marshal's Refuge in Un'Goro Crater (client tables 48.1, 6.1; guide agrees).

points.name: Cinder
points.note: Summoned at the Red Archival Panel at the top of the mountain path west of the crater; fire elementals nearby.

points.name: Snowtalon
points.note: Summoned at the Blue Archival Panel in the cave behind the left waterfall north of Titanosaur.

points.name: Titanosaur
points.note: Giant devilsaur patrolling the paved road through the middle; clear adds first.

points.name: Izha'Rel and Tor'Rel
points.note: Fire and ice raptor pair patrolling the dirt path east of the road; kill Tor'Rel first. Ravasaur Stalkers join when low.

points.name: Vitrix
points.note: Summoned at the Green Archival Panel in the cave behind a mountain gate near the raptors; the guide says it can be skipped.

points.name: Direhorn Matriarch
points.note: East edge of the crater; stay out of the tail sweep behind her.

points.name: Thunderhoof
points.note: Southern rim, a little west of centre by a lake squeeze.

points.name: Venomridge
points.note: South of the Achromatic Crystal in the tar pits; poison heavy.

points.name: Bolt
points.note: Summoned at the Yellow Archival Panel directly behind Venomridge.

points.name: Nanaya
points.note: Final boss summoned at the Titan Panel on the Pillar of Assimilation after all four panels are done.

points.name: Red / Blue / Green / Yellow Archival Panels
points.note: Each needs 15 Power Crystals of the matching color carried at once.

strategies.text: Kill Tor'Rel first, then Izha'Rel; the Ravasaur Stalker adds arrive near the end.
Can one-shot an under-geared group; skip it if you are not ready.
Do not stand behind her; the tail hits all around.

notes: Boss order and spots are only verbally described by the Warcraft Tavern guide, so boss x/y are null. Five of ten bosses are required to finish. The guide suggests one clockwise loop; actual order is free. Quest NPCs are in Mulgore / Undercity / Ironforge, not placed here. uiMapID unknown. Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
